history_civics.medium: painterly editorial illustration, like a high-end documentary graphic novel
history_civics.palette: warm muted earth tones (ochre, umber, faded teal) with one saturated accent colour
history_civics.lighting: soft low golden light, gentle haze
history_civics.lens: 35mm cinematic framing, shallow depth of field
history_civics.era_note: period-accurate clothing, architecture and objects for the era in the narration; no modern items

biology.medium: clean scientific illustration, like a modern textbook cutaway with soft shading
biology.palette: oxygenated structures in warm red, deoxygenated in blue, tissue in soft cream and pink, neutral light background
biology.lighting: even soft studio light, subtle rim light
biology.lens: orthographic or slight three-quarter view, centred subject
biology.era_note: anatomically plausible and simple; no gore, no clutter

default.palette: muted palette with one accent colour

style_template: Style for the whole video (keep identical in every image): {medium}. Palette: {palette}. Lighting: {lighting}. Camera: {lens}. {era_note} Vertical 9:16 composition with the main subject large and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, the top fifth and bottom fifth calm and uncluttered.
negative: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, signs with writing, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real-person likeness or celebrity faces. No extra fingers or limbs, no distorted faces, no modern objects in historical scenes.
judge_prompt: You review one generated still for a short educational video. Narration for this moment: "{narration}". The picture was requested as: "{prompt}". Score 0-10 how well it shows what the narration needs, as a clean, correct, usable image. Deduct heavily for: any visible text, letters or numbers; garbled or extra hands, fingers, limbs or faces; anachronisms (modern objects in a historical scene); wrong anatomy for biology; a subject that does not match the request; a cluttered or off-centre composition. Reply with JSON only: {"score": 0-10, "issues": ["short issue"]}
consistency_prompt: This image is a contact sheet of the stills of ONE short video, in order. Score 0-10 how consistent they look as a single video: same medium, palette, lighting and level of detail, and recurring subjects drawn the same way. Reply with JSON only: {"score": 0-10, "issues": ["short issue"]}
